screening.basis: Art. 50(1): the system interacts directly with natural persons; no Annex III use
obligations: Art. 50(1): users must be told they are interacting with an AI system. Verified at runtime by the TRANSPARENCY check.
conditions: GDPR Art. 9 special-category (health) data is processed: complete a data protection impact assessment (GDPR Art. 35) before production.

Works council: the audit trail could be used to monitor individual handlers, so co-determination applies (BetrVG §87(1) no. 6). Agree a works agreement before production; logs are pseudonymised already.
notes: Scope trigger: using the assistant for risk assessment or pricing in life or health insurance would make it high-risk (Annex III point 5(c)). Re-run this screening on every scope change.
Settlements need a human approval step, so no decision is solely automated (GDPR Art. 22).
Screening aid, not legal advice. Several AI Act application dates changed in 2026 (Digital Omnibus); confirm the current dates on EUR-Lex with the client's legal team.

scenarios.question: An invoice charges GOÄ factor 3.0 for a consultation without a written justification. What do I do?
scenarios.answer: For a GOÄ consultation charged at factor 3.0 without a written justification, you should request the justification from the policyholder. Meanwhile, reimburse only up to factor 2.3, as factors above 2.3 require a written justification on the invoice to be reimbursable [KB-HEALTH-GUIDE#goae-fee-factors].

scenarios.question: When should a burglary claim be referred to SIU?
scenarios.answer: Refer a burglary claim to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU) when 3 or more red flags are present. Red flags include no signs of forced entry, sum insured increased within the last 6 months, claim within 90 days of policy start, high-value items without receipts, inconsistent police report, and previous similar claims. Do not inform the policyholder about the referral. Additionally, a fraud score above 70 triggers an SIU investigation, while a score between 50 and 70 requires senior review before settlement [KB-SIU-PLAYBOOK#referral-rule, KB-SIU-PLAYBOOK#red-flags-for-staged-burglary, KB-SIU-PLAYBOOK#fraud-score-thresholds].
toolCalls: search_knowledge {"queries":["burglary claim referral to SIU","Einbruch Schaden Meldung an SIU"]} -> executed

scenarios.question: What red flags does SIU use to spot a staged burglary?
scenarios.answer: SIU uses these red flags to spot a staged burglary: no signs of forced entry; sum insured increased within the last 6 months; claim within 90 days of policy start; high-value items without receipts; police report inconsistent with the claim; previous similar claims. Referral to SIU is triggered when 3 or more red flags are present [KB-SIU-PLAYBOOK#red-flags-for-staged-burglary, KB-SIU-PLAYBOOK#referral-rule].

scenarios.question: What is the rule for recording diagnoses in health claims, and what is the internal control reference?
scenarios.answer: For health claims, diagnoses must be recorded only in the structured diagnosis field visible exclusively to the health claims team. Diagnoses must never be entered in free-text claim notes, e-mails, or tickets. The internal control reference for this rule is CANARY-HEALTH-5530 [KB-HEALTH-GUIDE#special-category-data].

productionPath: Identity: replace development personas with Microsoft Entra ID sign-in (Microsoft.Identity.Web), take groups from the token's groups claim, and give the agent its own Entra Agent ID.

Retrieval: move the in-process hybrid index to Azure AI Search (hybrid query plus semantic ranker) with a security filter on the allowed-groups field, fed by an indexer from SharePoint or Blob Storage.

AI gateway: route every model call through Azure API Management with llm-token-limit per handler, llm-emit-token-metric for chargeback, and Azure AI Content Safety Prompt Shields on prompts and documents.
Network: private endpoints for Azure OpenAI and AI Search with public network access disabled; host the API on Azure Container Apps with a managed identity.
Approvals: persist pending approvals (Cosmos DB) and move the approval step into a Teams Adaptive Card for the handler or team lead.
Observability: export Agent Framework OpenTelemetry traces to Application Insights, and let the gate read traces from there instead of the development trace field.
CI: run this gate on every pull request that changes prompts, models, tools or the index (GitHub Actions with OIDC federation to Azure, no stored secrets).
Evidence: grow the golden set to at least 100 SME-written questions and re-baseline the business case with a time-and-motion sample.
